description: This file contains unit tests for the EagerSession class in the TensorFlow Java API. It verifies behaviors such as resource cleanup, session closing, garbage collection handling, and default session management.

classes.name: EagerSessionTest
classes.description: Test suite for the EagerSession class, covering session lifecycle, resource management, garbage collection, and default session handling.

methods.name: closeSessionTwiceDoesNotFail
methods.description: Tests that closing the session twice does not throw an exception.

methods.name: cleanupResourceOnSessionClose
methods.description: Ensures resources are cleaned up when the session is closed with ON_SESSION_CLOSE strategy.

methods.name: cleanupResourceOnSafePoints
methods.description: Verifies resource cleanup occurs at safe points when using ON_SAFE_POINTS strategy.

methods.name: cleanupResourceInBackground
methods.description: Checks that resource cleanup in background thread works as expected.

methods.name: setResourceNotCleanedWhenRefCleared
methods.description: Ensures that clearing a reference prevents cleanup.

methods.name: buildingOpWithClosedSessionFails
methods.description: Confirms that building an operation with a closed session throws an exception.

methods.name: addingReferenceToClosedSessionFails
methods.description: Validates that adding a reference to a closed session fails.

methods.name: defaultSession
methods.description: Tests default session initialization, access, and error cases.
